Implemented via held-out TDD. RED→GREEN evidence:
- Oracle: tests/interfaces/contracts/test_llmrunner_error_codes_f75f.py (happy: LLMInputRejectedError→command_failed, LLMUnavailableError→llm_unavailable) + _heldout.py (edge: every LLMRunnerError subclass→command_failed; reserve LLMUnavailableError/LLMConfigError→llm_unavailable; dbca WorkflowNotFound→not_found, parse/validation/version/unknown-step→invalid_input PRESERVED; bare WorkflowError/LLMError bases→llm_unavailable; E2E through the MCP gate-tool failure envelope _structured_llm_failure).
- RED-first: 10 failed / 6 passed for the right reason. Implementer subagent saw the happy-path file only.
- GREEN after fix: 16 passed.
- Implementation: error_code_for branch 7 extracted into sibling _llm_error_code helper (mirrors branch 6's _workflow_caller_code seam); LLMRunnerError→command_failed before the LLMError→llm_unavailable fallthrough. dbca branch 6 + bare bases untouched.
- Complexity: extraction kept error_code_for under max-complexity=15 (baseline new=0 increased=0). lint + typecheck clean.
- Mutation-teeth (sandbox-exec): flipping the LLMRunnerError branch return to llm_unavailable turned 9 held-out tests RED; restored → GREEN.
- Full unit suite: 18120 passed, 8 pre-existing env failures (git-remote/isolation plumbing) — confirmed identical on pristine origin/main WITHOUT this change, unrelated.

Landed as Gerrit change 2413 (stack bottom): https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2413 — DCO signed, Change-Id Ib41b6a3eecffa5111da3101d90171243d745997b. Awaiting Verified+1 and LLM-Review+1 before close.
